designationHistory.indexText: The Interior Department formally established Browns Park National Wildlife Refuge on the Green River in northwest Colorado by withdrawing public land for it under Public Land Order 4973.
designationHistory.note: The CCP says the refuge was formally established by PLO 4973 of December 11, 1970; the order appears in the December 17, 1970 Federal Register. Land purchases under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act began earlier (CCP); those dates were not verified.
